description: Returns one roster owned by the signed-in player, by an id from list_my_rosters. summary names each unit with its points, models, wargear, enhancements, Warlord and attachments, and gives the total and any problems that stop the list being fielded; it is null while army data is unavailable. roster holds the saved choices by catalogue id, the shape save_roster takes. Requires mcp:read.
name: get_my_roster
title: Read my saved roster
